instruction.text: Wo hörst du dieses Wort? Wähle aus.
Schreibe die fehlenden Wörter in die Lücken.

atoms.a: When I went on a school trip to England, I quickly noticed that people often ask “How are you?” as a greeting. I was really confused the first couple of times and I didn't really know how to answer at the time.

atoms.a: My friends and I came to understand that, for the locals, this is a way to be polite for the locals. Slowly, we started to answer them and even ask the same question back.

atoms.a: It was funny to realise that small cultural habits can quickly make you feel lost even though they are intended to be polite.

instruction.text: Höre dir an, wie man ein traditionelles englisches Frühstück zubereitet. Achte auf die Arbeitsschritte.

atoms.sound: Making a traditional Full English Breakfast is all about the timing. First, you start by frying the sausages in a pan over medium heat, as they need the longest to cook. After a few minutes, you add the bacon, some tomatoes and mushrooms to the same pan so they soak up in the flavour. Next, while the meat is frying, you warm up the baked beans in a small saucepan. Then, you fry an egg in some oil until the white is firm, but the inside is still soft. Finally, you toast a slice of bread, put everything together on a warm plate, and serve it with a hot cup of English breakfast tea.

Toast a slice of bread and serve everything on a warm plate with tea.
